title: GPT-3: Few-Shot In-Context Learners: Part 1 - The Death of Fine-Tuning: Moving from Weight Updates to Natural Language Prompts

beats.text: Why do GPUs sit idle during LLM inference until GPT-3 unlocks 98.2% throughput?
The core challenge? While typically task-agnostic in architecture, this method still requires task-specific fine-tuning datasets of thousands or tens of thousands of examples.
beats.visual_focus: Bottleneck diagram illustrating resource contention and latency walls.

beats.text: Enter GPT-3: by contrast, humans can generally perform a new language task from only a few examples or from simple instructions - something which current NLP systems still largely struggle to do.
